findings: Every cached key is constructed from one current tuple snapshot of an exact builtin list of exact builtin finite floats. Big-endian IEEE754 packing preserves every bit, signed zero and length; it uses direct bytes equality rather than a digest or mutable ndarray identity.

The original pinned encoder is bound once per instance. Misses encode a plain-list copy of the same snapshot; successful original bytes are retained only after encoding returns. Unsupported calls pass the original object unchanged and retain the previous entry. Exceptions are neither cached nor retried.

EncodingMemo is allocated as the first statement inside each actual fit callback. Only EncodingAssembly.resolve is overridden. Inherited source recovery/cache, selected forecasts, full assembly routing and fallback selection remain unchanged. No cache or encoder rebinding is global; separate callbacks cannot share memo entries.

The descriptor and reconstruction copies are AST-identical after exactly the reviewed encode-parameter substitution. The source-law wrapper also retains the archive require binding, so unqualified classes and descriptor failures retain AdmissionFailure rather than forecast ValueError.

The resolve copy is AST-identical after local memo creation and the three explicit callable arguments. It still executes original native resolution, reason/fallback guards, strict JSON conversion, mapper.components, SHA comparison, beta/rates checks, law construction, moments validation, frozen copies, complete descriptor roundtrip and callback failure/accounting metadata.

For identical successful alpha contents the intended saving is repeated serialization only: fitted descriptor encodes once, independent recovered alpha and recovered descriptor may hit. Snapshot/type/finite scans and full bit keys still execute on every call. Components, hashing and all checks are not memoized.
Fallback self.recover retains its inherited original encoder path. The new memo can cover only the later descriptor/reconstruction roundtrip, not the inherited fallback recovery itself.
limits: Static review only: no module imported, no tests, scoring, fitting, recovery, scientific or historical calls executed. AST parsing and metadata hashing are the only executable verification here.
No numerical equality, performance, capacity, full-controller integration or historical authorization is established.
Pinned original encoder always returns immutable bytes; behavior under deliberate replacement with an arbitrary non-bytes encoder is outside the shipping contract.
Synchronous use only; new snapshot/key allocations do not promise identical resource-exhaustion behavior or safety against concurrent caller mutation.
Driver and independently authored tests were not part of this source-only acceptance.
required_remaining_qualification: Independent focused tests of mutation, signed zero, unsupported inputs, encoder failures/commit ordering and cross-callback isolation.
Original/candidate corruption tests proving components/hash/moment/schema/fallback/roundtrip failures remain equal in type and message.
Static driver/test review, exact source/runtime/input pins, and one bounded complete callback qualification with save-before-assert evidence.
Independent post-terminal exactness and unprofiled separate-max cost review against the unchanged target.
